acip: CHOS LA ZHES SOGS KYIS CHOS KYI BDAG MED DE BZHIN NYID CES BRJOD PA GANG LA DMIGS NAS BSGOMS PAS SGRIB PA DAG PAR 'GYUR BA DE NYID YONGS GRUB TU NGOS BZUNG NGO , ,
wylie: chos la zhes sogs kyis chos kyi bdag med de bzhin nyid ces brjod pa gang la dmigs nas bsgoms pas sgrib pa dag par 'gyur ba de nyid yongs grub tu ngos bzung ngo ,
english: The phrasing around the words "of objects" is saying, "that thing we talk about as the lack of any self-nature of objects, or the essential nature of things." Totality is being identified as that one thing which--if you focus on it and then meditate upon it--your spiritual obstacles are cleaned away.
